description: Annual herb. Solitary heads on branched, leafy stems. 10-20 white ray florets, usually reflexed downward as the head ages, around a PROMINENT HOLLOW CONICAL yellow disc that stands proud of the rays. Leaves finely bipinnate into thread-like segments.
source: Flora of North America vol. 19 (Matricaria); POWO taxon profile
notes: The raised yellow disc is the identifying feature and must FACE THE VIEWER; a head photographed from behind shows only the green receptacle and is not acceptable however sharp. A stem must be visible. Feathery foliage is welcome but is often reduced to a thin stem in a good close-up, so it is preferred, not required.
